instruction: After the attempted start at tick 10, the ball should be below its launch area by frames 40..50: its top edge must be below y=300. The ball starts at y=200 and moves downward at at least 400*cos(45 degrees) px/s before a paddle impact. Require the same paddle-left-lane checkpoint to avoid treating a menu as an exercised round. Draft: review timing and coordinate assumptions before approving.
